title: Target Car Seat Trade-In
summary: Target's Car Seat Trade-In event is back Sept. 20 through Oct. 3. Recycle an old car seat, earn a 20% Target Circle bonus and save on baby gear and more.
body_markdown:
Growing up happens fast. One day a little one is riding home from the hospital and before long, they’ve outgrown their infant car seat. That’s exactly why Target offers[Car Seat Trade-In](https://www.target.com/c/car-seat-trade-in-event/-/N-v41nu) : to make it easy for families to recycle an old car seat while saving on what’s next.


Now in its 10th year, the event returns September 20 through October 3, 2026, guests can bring any old car seat to a participating Target store and receive a 20% Target Circle bonus to use on new baby gear.


“As little ones grow, families’ needs change quickly, and they want a place where they can find trusted products, great prices and everything they need in one trip,” said **Amanda Nusz** , senior vice president of merchandising, essentials and beauty, Target. “Our Car Seat Trade-In event brings together convenience, value and a thoughtfully curated assortment, making it easy for parents to recycle a car seat while saving on the products their family needs today and for the stages ahead.”
